archive.catalogue_description: First time uploading a map, and second time making a map, so please give me some slack. I know this map isn’t too large but it’s not a box map and the close quarters could be considered a challenge to some. I’ll just save time for those of you that want a quick map to play while waiting on people. Credits: – Treyarch for making this “11/10 game” -IGN – GAM3VIDZ for tutorials – ZOMB1E-KLLR for tutorials – UGX for Pack-a-Punch prefab and hosting this Thanks for reading! Hope you enjoy this simple map

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
